item.text:
**Bottom line**
Putin did not refrain from manipulating the 2024 electoral environment. The evidence is one-sided: controlled media, subservient courts and security forces, exclusion of credible opposition, electoral fraud, and an OSCE/Freedom House pattern of non-competitive elections. I found no credible positive evidence that he left the process unmanipulated.

**Accepted Claims**

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Russia wins presidential election in landslide with no serious competition](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-presidential-vote-starts-final-day-with-accusations-of-kyiv-sabotage-3341069) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-presidential-vote-starts-final-day-with-accusations-of-kyiv-sabotage-3341069 | Reuters said Putin won a record landslide in an election that Western governments characterized as neither free nor fair, with imprisoned opponents and censorship narrowing the contest. This is direct evidence of manipulated electoral conditions. | `4B.2`, also `4B.1`, `4B.3` |
| [Russia: Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says the Kremlin manipulates elections, suppresses genuine opposition, and relies on subservient courts, security forces, and a controlled media environment. It also says Navalny was disqualified and the OSCE found a lack of genuine competition. | `4B.2`, also `4B.1`, `4B.3`, `4B.4` |
| [Russia: Nations in Transit 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Freedom House downgraded Russia’s electoral integrity because of omnipresent fraud, the absence of genuine opposition, violence, and intimidation of voters and domestic election monitors. That is strong evidence against non-manipulation. | `4B.2`, also `4B.1`, `4B.3`, `4B.4` |
| [Russia: Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House says the regime intensifed restrictions after the invasion of Ukraine, used paid commentators and bot networks, and maintained a controlled information environment. This supports the view that Putin’s political dominance was reinforced through manipulation rather than fair competition. | `4B.2`, also `4B.3`, `4B.4`, `3B.8` |

**Search Gap**
I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Putin refrained from manipulating electoral rules, courts, media, election commissions, security forces, or public resources. The only limited counterpoint is that the election was held and some symbolic protest occurred, but that does not show clean or genuine electoral contestation.
